record.paper_title: Erdős-Macintyre type theorem’s for multiple Dirichlet series: exceptional sets and open problems
record.original_question: Let f(z)=∑_{n=0}∞ a_n z^n be a nonconstant entire function, let M_f(r)=max{|f(z)|: |z|=r}, and let μ_f(r)=max_{n≥0}|a_n|r^n. For a fixed ε>0, Wiman's inequality is M_f(r)≤μ_f(r)(ln μ_f(r))^(1/2+ε) for all r outside an exceptional set E. If E=∪_{n=1}∞[a_n,b_n] satisfies ∫_E (ln r)^(1/2) d ln r<∞, does every such set E occur as an exceptional set for Wiman's inequality for some entire function f and that ε?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f(z)=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a_n z^n$ be a nonconstant entire function. Define the maximum modulus $M_f(r)=\max\{|f(z)|:|z|=r\}$ and the maximal term $\mu_f(r)=\max_{n\ge 0}|a_n|r^n$. Fix $\varepsilon>0$. A classical inequality of Wiman asserts that
$$M_f(r)\le \mu_f(r)\bigl(\ln \mu_f(r)\bigr)^{1/2+\varepsilon}$$
holds for all $r$ outside some exceptional set $E\subset[1,\infty)$.

Suppose $E$ is a union $E=\bigcup_{n=1}^{\infty}[a_n,b_n]$ of closed intervals satisfying the refined size condition
$$\int_{E}(\ln r)^{1/2}\,d\ln r<\infty.$$

Question: Does every such set $E$ arise as an exceptional set for Wiman's inequality, in the sense that for the chosen $\varepsilon$ there exists an entire function $f$ for which Wiman's inequality holds precisely outside $E$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is explicitly posed as an open question concerning sharpness/realizability of exceptional sets in refined Wiman-type inequalities. Recent literature (e.g., Carpathian Mathematical Publications papers on h-measure of exceptional sets and MDPI Axioms 2025 on analogs of Wiman's theorem) continues to study size conditions for exceptional sets but does not report a resolution of this specific realizability question.

status_evidence.title: Wiman's type inequality for analytic and entire functions and h-measure of an exceptional set
status_evidence.snippet: Studies size/measure conditions on exceptional sets in Wiman-type inequalities.
status_evidence.claim: Active research on exceptional sets for Wiman's inequality continues, without a known resolution of the stated realizability question.

status_evidence.title: Entire Functions of Several Variables: Analogs of Wiman's Theorem
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work develops analogs of Wiman's theorem and discusses exceptional sets.
status_evidence.claim: Refined exceptional-set conditions remain a topic of current investigation.
